title: Start the personal newspaper pilot from the participant's goal
summary: The host entry point recovers a goal and authorized evidence, prepares a ready health section, and resumes via the same private Sheet.
outcome: Reviewed the participant entry point, role goals, fallback paths and manual pilot protocol. Local suite ran 127 tests with one skip. Synthetic CLI, attachment import/replay and HTTP restart checks passed. Live Dot URL interpretation, Sheet readback and fresh-chat continuation remain untested on this revision.
decisions: Use the private Sheet as team memory in the Dot pilot. Keep optional service storage separate.
Manager owns the ready section and the Chief of Staff controls newspaper delivery and timing.
next_actions: Run the two-visit participant test and record any necessary steering.
